'''Rhon Jun'yon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Warrior]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] as a [[Sith Warrior]] trainer during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He once trained the [[Empire's Wrath]].
